task:
Implement network segmentation using NetworkPolicy:

  Setup (create these first):
    kubectl create ns frontend
    kubectl create ns backend
    kubectl run frontend-pod --image=nginx:1.21 -n frontend --labels=role=frontend
    kubectl run backend-pod --image=nginx:1.21 -n backend --labels=role=backend

  Task:
  1. Create NetworkPolicy 'allow-frontend' in namespace 'backend' that:
     - Applies to pods with label role=backend
     - Allows ingress ONLY from pods in namespace 'frontend'
       (use namespaceSelector matching label kubernetes.io/metadata.name=frontend)
     - On port 80 only
     - Denies all other ingress (implicit — just don't add other ingress rules)

  2. Verify the policy is in place: kubectl describe networkpolicy allow-frontend -n backend
hints: NetworkPolicy requires a CNI that supports it (Calico, Cilium, Weave) — Kind uses Kindnet which may not support it
An empty policyTypes: [Ingress] with no ingress rules = deny all ingress
detailed_hints: Create namespaces first: kubectl create ns frontend && kubectl create ns backend
NetworkPolicy spec.podSelector: {matchLabels: {role: backend}} — targets backend pods

validators.description: NetworkPolicy allow-frontend exists in backend namespace
